support_meta.method: For each first-query stage and role, sample 32 directions at 11.25 degree increments in the named 2D projection. Reference support is an LP over the exported full-state H set. Parallelotope support is the exact support of the exported frame-coordinate box in the same projected direction. Excess = parallelotope support - reference support. This is a sampled projection diagnostic, not a uniform error bound or an inclusion certificate. Geometry is sampled from measured repetition 1; the native frame bounds are deterministic across measured repetitions.
